info.title: StoryRun-lite API
info.description: Local synthetic Parent demo contract for the continuous S1→S2 slice. S2 permits HTTP loopback only; this contract does not authorize live provider calls.

post.summary: Create a synthetic Parent story run
post.description: The actor is resolved server-side. The client cannot select an owner identity. Exact Idempotency-Key and request replay returns the stored status and body.

get.summary: Read current run state and result

200.description: Current run snapshot; a result is exposed only in SUBJECT_REVIEW

post.description: This command attaches an asset reference; image bytes are uploaded through an upload session.

202.description: Accepted for one Vision attempt or exact replay

Cache-Control.description: Successful command responses must not be cached.

post.description: Only CONFIRM is supported. The decision and FINAL command receipt commit together. Replay of the same key/fingerprint returns the original 202 without another decision or Vision attempt.

Cache-Control.description: Successful command responses must not be cached.

post.summary: Cancel a run or close the demo after preparation review
post.description: Cancel an eligible unfinished run, including SUBJECT_REVIEW, or explicitly close the demo from PREPARATION_REVIEW. The transition to DELETE_PENDING releases the active-owner lock while retaining the run, admitted assets, result and command receipts. Cancellation does not claim that an external provider or GPU stopped. A post-SENT unknown ledger outcome remains unknown; no automatic resend occurs.

202.description: Run moved to DELETE_PENDING and active lock released

Cache-Control.description: Successful command responses must not be cached.

post.summary: Create an upload session for a run artwork
post.description: Server-advertised limits are authoritative. Current targets are 20 MiB total, 4 MiB per part and at most five contiguous parts.

201.description: Upload session created or exact replay

put.summary: Store one contiguous raw binary part
put.description: Part numbers start at one. An exact same-part/same-digest retry is idempotent; a different digest for an existing part returns 409.

schema.description: One raw image byte range; maximum size is the server-advertised part_size_bytes.

post.summary: Verify aggregate bytes and begin admission
post.description: Missing parts return UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE without consuming the command key. The server hashes concatenated bytes in ascending part order. Scanner CLEAN on the exact immutable snapshot precedes every parser, decoder and Vision call.

202.description: Admission started; poll the upload resource

Cache-Control.description: Successful command responses must not be cached.

get.summary: Read upload state, parts, limits and expiry

delete.description: The state transition is committed before best-effort deletion of staged synthetic bytes.

Cache-Control.description: Successful command responses must not be cached.

get.description: Checks the configured runtime and the pinned PostgreSQL singleton session. Returns 503 after ownership is lost; it does not reacquire the lock. The infrastructure /health endpoint is liveness only.

200.description: The configured runtime currently owns its singleton lock.

post.summary: Generate a Parent story draft from the confirmed drawing
post.description: Uses server-owned age context, the confirmed subject and the current image understanding revision. Parent requests cannot contain activities. Generation is bounded to one initial revision and three AI rewrites; every output remains DRAFT until adult confirmation. This operation does not start video generation.

201.description: Story draft persisted and ready for adult review

Cache-Control.description: Private responses must not be cached.

202.description: Generation outcome needs polling/reconciliation; never auto-resend

Cache-Control.description: Private responses must not be cached.

get.summary: Read an owned immutable story revision and its ordered scenes

Cache-Control.description: Private responses must not be cached.

post.summary: Confirm the exact reviewed story revision before downstream video admission
post.description: Confirms only when If-Match, revision number, understanding revision, and story hash still match. It does not call video generation.

200.description: Story revision confirmed; video has not started

Cache-Control.description: Private responses must not be cached.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Current quoted ETag returned by the resource, encoding its expected revision/version.

ContentSha256.name: Content-SHA256
ContentSha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of this exact part; the server recalculates and verifies it.

ETag.description: Opaque strong version token; send back unchanged in If-Match.

child_age_months.description: Exact profile age in months; null only on runs created before this contract.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request or idempotency fingerprint mismatch

ContentLengthRequired.description: Raw part upload requires a Content-Length header

NotFound.description: Resource not found in the resolved synthetic Parent scope

Conflict.description: State, digest, idempotency or expected revision conflict

PreconditionRequired.description: If-Match is required for this versioned command

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Upload part media type must be application/octet-stream

UploadExpired.description: Upload session expiry has been enforced

ValidationError.description: Request validation or complete-upload part validation failed

Unavailable.description: Required local dependency is unavailable; fail closed

InternalError.description: Unexpected internal error returned by the shared HTTP exception handler
